fieldName: Chance of a mission board per bar
fieldDescription: Chance in percent that a bar has a mission board. The board lists 1 to 5 contracts, more at bigger markets. Size 3 markets rarely have one, smaller markets never. Each bar rolls again about every 20 to 40 days.

How much the tier roll favours tiers that match your fleet size, colony income and credits. 0 is fully random. 100 makes the matching tier twice as likely and its neighbours one and a half times. Every tier in the range below stays possible.
Bars never offer contracts below this tier. If it is set above the highest tier, the two swap.
Bars never offer contracts above this tier.

Clients only offer the lowest tiers at first. Finish enough contracts to open the next tiers: with the default settings, 3 contracts of tier 0 or 1 open tiers 2 and 3, 3 of tier 2 or higher open 4 and 5, and 3 of tier 4 or higher open 6 and 7. Off: every tier is open from the start.
With Proving yourself on: how many finished contracts of the open tiers, or higher, open the next tiers. Buying or selling a ship and investments do not count.
With Proving yourself on: how many tiers open together. 2: tiers 0 and 1 are open from the start, then 2 and 3, then 4 and 5, then 6 and 7. 1: one tier at a time.

Multiplies the pay of crew transport, on top of the reward multiplier.
Multiplies the pay of contributions, on top of the reward multiplier.

Multiplies the pay of raids and garrison duty, on top of the reward multiplier.

Every bar gets a mission board with an extra option to spawn any job type at any tier, ignoring the job type and tier settings above, and open contracts get buttons to complete or fail them at once. Leave it off for normal play.
